2609.02421.title: UTP-Bench: Uncertainty-aware Travel Planning Benchmark
2609.02421.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in automated travel itinerary generation. However, real- world travel planning is inherently uncertain: transportation delays, crowd fluctuations, and unexpected stochastic delays frequently inval- idate otherwise feasible schedules. Existing benchmarks like TravelPlanner and TripCraft assume deterministic environments, evaluating only static constraint satisfaction and ignoring whether generated plans remain robust when such uncertainties arise. To address this limitation, we introduce UTP-Bench1 , a large-scale benchmark for uncertainty-aware travel planning. The dataset integrates real-world travel data spanning 504 cities of India, including attractions, restau- rants, accommodations, and multi-modal trans- portation networks. To model realistic disrup- tions, UTP-Bench incorporates empirical delay distributions and crowd-density patterns col- lected from major cities, enabling evaluation of travel plans under stochastic conditions. We further propose three evaluation metrics, namely Buffer Adequacy Score (BAS), Crowd- Aware Timing Score (CATS), and Transport Delay Absorption Score (TDAS), which quan- tify the ability of generated itineraries to main- tain robustness against transit delays and crowd variability. Experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs like GPT-5, Qwen3, Mistral and Phi-4 re- veal substantial gaps between model-generated and human-authored plans, particularly in tem- poral buffering, delay-aware transportation scheduling, and crowd-sensitive planning.
2609.02421.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）最近在自動化旅行行程生成方面展現了強大的能力。<lb/>然而，現實世界的旅行規劃本質上是不確定的：交通延誤、人群波動和意外的隨機延遲經常使得原本可行的時間表失效。<lb/>現有的基準如TravelPlanner和TripCraft假設在確定性環境中運行，只評估靜態約束滿足，而忽略了在這些不確定性出現時生成的計劃是否仍然穩健。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們引入了UTP-Bench1，一個針對不確定性感知旅行規劃的大型基準。<lb/>該數據集整合了涵蓋印度504個城市的現實旅行數據，包括景點、餐廳、住宿和多模式交通網絡。<lb/>為了模擬現實中的干擾，UTP-Bench納入了從主要城市收集的經驗性延遲分布和人群密度模式，使得在隨機條件下評估旅行計劃成為可能。<lb/>我們進一步提出了三個評估指標，即緩衝充足性分數（BAS）、人群感知時間分數（CATS）和交通延遲吸收分數（TDAS），這些指標量化了生成的行程在面對交通延遲和人群變異時保持穩健性的能力。<lb/>與最先進的LLMs如GPT-5、Qwen3、Mistral和Phi-4的實驗顯示，模型生成的計劃與人類撰寫的計劃之間存在顯著差距，特別是在時間緩衝、延遲感知交通調度和人群敏感規劃方面。
